label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 81
title: MVP: diagram viewer (mermaid + draw.io + PDF/SVG)
body:
## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0099)
[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] DIAGRAM RENDERING MUST SUCCEED.
Diagrams in specs MUST actually render to .drawio/SVG/PDF. The observed
"[DIAGRAMS] ... 0 rendered via unavailable" (renderer unavailable) is unacceptable: either make
the renderer available or the stage must still emit drawio/svg/pdf.
